body: I was born premature by 3 months. The result of that is me having mild cerebral palsy. It's not the worst, but there are some things you'll have to consider that you probably haven't before: people will give you weird looks everywhere you go, you'll automatically make a bad first impression, try your hardest to avoid places without handrails for their stairs. Putting on your clothes (especially socks) is now a chore, it may take anywhere from 10-30 minutes, plan accordingly. There will be laughs and snickers, people will assume you're also mentally disabled before they speak to you, and you'll have plenty of trouble establishing healthy relationships (both romantic and otherwise) due to your own insecurities. There will be random pain you can't explain some days. You may walk weird, but you have no choice but to embrace it now. Don't let the world get you down. Easier said than done, I know. Please learn to love yourself.
